$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：天同獨坐巳亥，《深造講義》p.178。

basis.quote: 须详其为意志薄弱，抑为意志坚强

rules.text: 你的天同得祿，又稍見煞星，意志反而堅強。
rules.en: Your Tian Tong gains Lu and meets a touch of malefics, which actually strengthens your will.

source.quote: 必须稍见一二点煞曜，然后始主意志坚强

rules.text: 你的天同得祿而不見煞，容易流於意志薄弱。
rules.en: Your Tian Tong gains Lu with no malefics in view, so your will can slide into weakness.

source.quote: 否则可能沦为意志薄弱

rules.text: 你的天同化權，意志堅強：情緒受到管束，天份因此得以發揮。
rules.en: Your Tian Tong is transformed by Quan, which makes your will strong: emotions held in check let your talent come through.

source.quote: 因而得以发挥其天份的象征

rules.text: 你的天同與天馬或陀羅同宮，你的毅力至少會有所不足。
rules.en: Your Tian Tong shares the palace with Tian Ma or Tuo Luo, which at the least means staying power falls short.

rules.text: 這裡說的意志薄弱，不一定是沒有毅力；有時只是創業的魄力不足，或者喜歡四處漂泊。
rules.en: Weak will here doesn't necessarily mean no staying power; sometimes it only means less drive to build something, or a love of wandering.

source.quote: 便仅指创兴事业的魄力

rules.text: 貪狼所在的那一步運，無論見不見吉星，對你都好，往往帶來良好的轉變。
rules.en: The phase through Tan Lang suits you, with or without helpful stars, and often brings a change for the better.

source.quote: 往往主出现良好转变的运势

rules.text: 意志堅強的你，行到武曲天府所在的運，往往就是發展的時候。
rules.en: With a firm will, the phase through Wu Qu–Tian Fu is often your time to grow.

source.quote: 坚强者喜行，往往为生发之运

rules.text: 魄力偏弱的你，不喜行到破軍所在的運：那段時間人生容易有重大的變化。
rules.en: With less drive, the phase through Po Jun does not suit you: life is prone to major upheaval then.

source.quote: 为意志薄弱的天同所不喜
